title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — November 11, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.0 (Peaked November 11, 2026 at 04:25 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C9.3 (Peaked November 10, 2026 at 08:34 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 530 km/s (Elevated)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Little burst of solar energy! 🔥🚀

Several bright active regions and broad coronal-hole areas are visible across today’s Sun, while the coronagraph shows no clear large outward structure.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
